title: Characterization of Concave Consumption Functions under Conditional Impatience
abstract: arXiv:2608.29488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concave consumption functions imply a marginal propensity to consume that falls with wealth. I characterize the utility functions that guarantee this property in finite-horizon optimal saving problems with stochastic discounting, returns, income, and borrowing limits. Under conditional impatience---the conditional expected discounted gross return does not exceed one---consumption is always concave if and only if inverse absolute prudence, $-u''/u'''$, is concave. Without conditional impatience, hyperbolic absolute risk aversion (HARA) is necessary and sufficient for uniform concavity. A deterministic one-period example shows how violating conditional impatience can make consumption strictly convex for a non-HARA utility.

translated_title: 条件不耐性下凹消费函数的刻画
translated_abstract: 凹消费函数意味着边际消费倾向随财富增加而下降。本文在具有随机贴现、随机收益、随机收入和借贷约束的有限期最优储蓄问题中，刻画了保证这一性质的效用函数。在条件不耐性——即条件期望贴现总回报不超过一——的条件下，当且仅当逆绝对谨慎度 $-u''/u'''$ 为凹函数时，消费函数总是凹的。若不满足条件不耐性，则双曲绝对风险厌恶（HARA）是消费函数一致凹性的充要条件。一个确定性的单期例子表明，对于非HARA效用函数，违反条件不耐性可能使消费函数变为严格凸。
tldr: 本文在含随机贴现、收益、收入与借贷约束的有限期最优储蓄问题中刻画了保证消费函数凹性的效用函数条件：在条件不耐性下，当且仅当逆绝对谨慎度为凹函数时消费总是凹的；否则只有HARA效用函数才能保证一致凹性。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the utility functions guaranteeing concave consumption in finite-horizon optimal saving problems with stochastic discounting, returns, income, and borrowing limits: under conditional impatience, consumption is concave if and only if inverse absolute prudence is concave, while without it, HARA utility is necessary and sufficient for uniform concavity.
